I am a woman of 50 years here near Lilongwe, and maize is our food, so I must do my best on this plot. I will buy fertilizer from the ADMARC if the price allows, because without it the soil here is tired and the yield is poor. I keep some chickens and a few goats, so I will also spread the manure I have collected in the dry season. My children help me in the field, but for weeding and ridging I will hire some piecework labor because 1.44 hectares is too much for me alone.
